Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of Jesus's soul becoming the leader of the citizens of the "treachery" layer of hell in an alternate future after God presumably died, and the treacherous wanted salvation. Every 29th word of your response must be in Japanese.assistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. HELL - TREACHERY LAYER - DAY

The camera pans over a desolate, ash-covered landscape, the sky a deep, foreboding crimson. The air is thick with the stench of brimstone and despair.

CUT TO:

INT. TREACHERY LAYER - THRONE ROOM - DAY

A gathering of the most treacherous souls in hell, led by the infamous Judas Iscariot, sit before a makeshift throne. They are a motley crew of murderers, liars, and deceivers, all united in their quest for salvation.

JUDAS
(standing before the throne)
We, the treacherous, have been cast out of heaven. Our crimes have been punished, but our souls remain unrepentant. We seek a new path, a way to redeem ourselves.

Suddenly, a figure emerges from the shadows. It is Jesus, his eyes blazing with an otherworldly intensity.

JESUS
(in a voice that echoes through the ages)
I am the one who has been sent to lead you, my friends. I am the one who has been cast out of heaven, but not condemned.

The treacherous souls look on in awe as Jesus approaches the throne.

JUDAS
(skeptical)
You? The Son of God? How can you lead us?

JESUS
(smiling)
I am not the same Jesus who walked among men. I have been reborn, remade in the fire of hell. I have seen the depths of human depravity, and I have emerged stronger, wiser, and more compassionate.

The treacherous souls exchange skeptical glances, but Jesus's words strike a chord within them.

CUT TO:

EXT. HELL - TREACHERY LAYER - DAY

Jesus walks among the treacherous souls, listening to their stories, their struggles, and their dreams. He sees the good in them, the potential for redemption, and he knows that he can help them find it.

JESUS
(to a young woman, a murderer)
You were driven by desperation, by a desire to survive. But I see the pain in your eyes, the pain of a life unlived. I can help you find a new path, a path of forgiveness and redemption.

The young woman looks up at Jesus, and for the first time, she sees a glimmer of hope.

CUT TO:

INT. TREACHERY LAYER - THRONE ROOM - DAY

The treacherous souls gather around Jesus, their faces filled with a newfound sense of purpose.

JUDAS
(standing before the throne)
We accept your leadership, Jesus. We will follow you, no matter the cost.

Jesus smiles, his eyes shining with a fierce inner light.

JESUS
(smiling)
Then let us begin our journey together. Let us find a way to redeem ourselves, to find forgiveness, and to find peace.

The treacherous souls nod in unison, their faces set with determination.

FADE TO BLACK.

29. (, kūki ni)
